thesis: The page is the homeowner's electric bill after a skeptic marked it up: every figure is circled in copper, and a leader line traces it to the line it came from.

signature.name: Source Trace
signature.summary: Copper numbered source ring + right-angle dotted leader line that draws to its source + a mono Sources strip closing each section. Hero ring's leader crosses the 50/50 seam onto the photo; story chain extends ring to ring; price rows and review tags carry rings; checklist ticks fill rings; second-opinion proposal sheet is marked with rings; footer holds the full Sources index. Hover a ring and its row lights sky blue.

palette.family: Monsoon Night + Bill-Paper + Meter Copper + Data Sky

layoutMoves: 50/50 hero whose seam is the first leader line
right margin source column (2 of 12 cols) carrying ring callouts on desktop
pinned 4-sheet stacked story with a lengthening leader chain
drawn SVG proposal sheet with margin marks instead of a photo

motion.intro: h1 line-mask rise 700ms; hero ring pops at 300ms and its leader draws across the seam in 600ms; default result counts up in 500ms
stories: draw: pinned chain, leader line extends sheet to sheet via --sw-p, rings pop on arrival
wipe: Sources rows wipe in with 60ms stagger at each section end, matching rings pulse once
motion.hover: copper hairline underline scaleX 0->1 from left 200ms; ring hover lights its Sources row in sky
